name: sarathi-business
description: Checks for the JavaScript inside the app's pages. Not a build step - the pages ship as they are written; this only reads them and reports names that are not there.

scripts.check:pages: node deploy/verify-page-js.mjs static/nidaan_ops.html static/nidaan_dashboard.html static/nidaan_start.html static/nidaan_review.html static/nidaan_signup.html static/nidaan_login.html static/nidaan_index.html static/partner.html static/dashboard.html static/superadmin.html
scripts.check:all: npm run check:pages && npm run check:py
